card.name: Mixed spots in anesthetic and pain dosing text
card.fires_on: Small connecting spots in local anesthetic and pain-treatment label text: the space after "to" before a number, "such" or "as" before examples, and the middle of "Spinal".

modes.label: Space in dose ranges
modes.description: A bare space after "to" in a numeric range of concentrations or volumes, just before the next number.

modes.label: "such as" before examples
modes.description: The word "such" or "as" introducing examples of procedures or nerve blocks.
modes.example: During major regional nerve blocks, such<< as>> those of the brachial plex

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: A partway piece of a term such as spinal cord injury.
